manual_reference_access.approved_title: Neurexins induce differentiation of GABA and glutamate postsynaptic specializations via neuroligins.
manual_reference_access.native_title: Neurexins induce differentiation of GABA and glutamate postsynaptic specializations via neuroligins.
manual_reference_access.approved_reading_scope: Authentic PubMed identity and the immutable main full-text cache were read. Selected Results and Methods (cache lines 90–123 and 167–199) explicitly report gamma2/alpha2 receptor clustering on dendrites, MAP2 colabeling and live-cell antibody evidence of surface localization; Methods describe E18 rat hippocampal cultures and gamma2-specific antibodies. This establishes a gamma2 dendritic-surface context in the coculture model, not gamma2 as the neurexin/neuroligin synaptogenic executor or proof of every native human compartment. Original images and supplements were not inspected. Earlier BioC error and browser challenge responses remain historical access failures; they do not describe the subsequently located main cache.

manual_reference_access.approved_title: Histamine action on vertebrate GABAA receptors: direct channel gating and potentiation of GABA responses.
manual_reference_access.native_title: Histamine action on vertebrate GABAA receptors: direct channel gating and potentiation of GABA responses.
manual_reference_access.approved_reading_scope: Authentic native PubMed abstract read alongside exact mouse P22723 donor IDA and UniProt records. Histamine directly gates beta2/beta3 homomers, whereas it potentiates alpha1/beta2(/gamma2) GABA responses in a gamma2-controlled manner. This supports the contextual cellular response, not gamma2 histamine binding. The abstract does not independently establish original clone species, natural product suffixes or full assay methods.

manual_reference_access.native_title: GABA(A) receptors can initiate the formation of functional inhibitory GABAergic synapses.
manual_reference_access.approved_reading_scope: Authentic selected original co-culture Results and Methods read in the retained alpha1 receptor study. Alpha1/beta2/gamma2-expressing cells form stable functional inhibitory contacts; gamma2 alone is not sufficient. This supports receptor participation in a reduced contact model, not a gamma2-only adhesion mechanism or universal in-vivo assembly role. The HEK host does not independently establish each clone species.

manual_reference_access.approved_title: The kinesin KIF21B participates in the cell surface delivery of γ2 subunit-containing GABAA receptors.
manual_reference_access.native_title: The kinesin KIF21B participates in the cell surface delivery of γ2 subunit-containing GABAA receptors.
manual_reference_access.approved_reading_scope: Authentic native abstract and exact rat P18508 UniProt evidence block read. Gamma2 specifically co-precipitates and co-localizes with KIF21B; knockdown reduces gamma2-containing receptor clusters and the authors support transport-vesicle delivery into dendrites. The target is gamma2, unlike unresolved alpha1/beta3-specific extensions of this source. Full Methods and detailed vesicle-population imaging remain inaccessible; gamma2 is receptor cargo, not the kinesin transport executor.

manual_reference_access.native_title: De novo GABRG2 mutations associated with epileptic encephalopathies.
manual_reference_access.approved_reading_scope: PubMed identity and indexed original PMC Methods plus selected Results were read. Human alpha1/beta2/gamma2L HEK293T assays compare wild type with six variants. HA is inserted after mature residue 4 for surface imaging; biotinylation and gamma2 immunoblots independently assess surface abundance. Whole-cell GABA currents support receptor function. Mutant ER retention does not establish an ER core function for wild-type gamma2. Structural calculations are models, not experimental structures. Some original prose has internally inconsistent variant names and percent-reduction wording; do not use those sentences for quantitative or variant-specific conclusions without checking the figures/supplement. No complete clone sequence or current suffix is inferred solely from gamma2L wording.

manual_reference_access.native_title: Structure of a human synaptic GABA(A) receptor.
manual_reference_access.approved_reading_scope: Authentic native original selected Results/Methods read. Human alpha1/beta2/gamma2 expression and patched structural constructs establish receptor function and benzodiazepine-interface contribution. Gamma2 carries an N-terminal twin-strep tag and an engineered M3–M4 loop replacement; this is not a natural short product. GABA sites are beta/alpha interfaces; flumazenil occupies the alpha/gamma interface. Mature-residue numbering and cDNA/transduction ratios differ from physiological stoichiometry. No current natural gamma2 suffix is assigned from the engineered construct alone.
